questions.questionTextHi: [Uttarakhand P.C.S. (Pre) 2006] Alaska is a part of which of the following countries?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (B) United State of America. Alaska is a province of United State of America situated in the North West extremity. The United State purchased Alaska from the Russian Empire on March 30, 1867.
